notablePrerequisites: Dawn's Reflection attached to a basic land you control.
description:
Activate the basic land with Dawn's Reflection attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Dawn's Reflection triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.
